name: Book of Dead

features.name: Expanding symbol
features.description: Before free spins a random symbol is chosen; during the bonus it expands to fill reels and pays on any position.

features.name: Gamble
features.description: Optional double-or-nothing card gamble on wins (removed in some markets).

review: Book of Dead is the template for the modern "book" slot. Ten free spins with a random expanding symbol is all there is, and that simplicity is its strength: the bonus outcome depends almost entirely on which symbol is picked. A high-paying expanding symbol can fill the screen, while a low one usually produces a modest bonus. Note the very wide range of RTP configurations – the in-game info screen tells you which one a casino runs.
cons: Operators may run RTPs far below 96.21%
sources: Provider game sheet / in-game info screen (verify before launch)
